turns.question: What share of leads created in September 2026 went on to a booking?
turns.answer: About 38.6% (0.386) of the leads created 1-30 September 2026 booked within 30 days of being created, measured with the lead-to-booking rate. Late: marketing.silver is ready only up to 2026-10-03T00:00Z, older than its 36 h deadline.
